headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 flash sets a fresh all-time record at 29.9% of tokens, and the lab tops 35.8%
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 claimed an all-time high at 29.9% of token share, and DeepSeek as a provider now sits at 35.8%. Meanwhile anthropic/claude-opus-5.5-20260921 is on day 2 of its own all-time record streak at 3.5%.
highlights: The top spot belongs to deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 at 29.9%, a fresh all-time record that is still only day one.
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI together hold 46.1% of token share, and the top five providers reach 69.9% with OpenAI, Xiaomi and Tencent in the mix.
anthropic/claude-opus-5.5-20260921 is on day 2 of its all-time record streak, now at 3.5% and sitting at No. 8.
New on the board: anthropic/claude-fable-5.1-20260831 debuts at No. 51 with 0.2% of tokens.
qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727 drops off the board after finishing at No. 50 with 0.2%.
